It is now that we are conducting you to holy demple, where you will bake your ceremonial donation to prove intentness of faith.|[[GrrKack]]|<ref name="Scavenger Hunt">[[Scavenger Hunt (adventure)|''Scavenger Hunt'']]</ref>}}
The '''Great Prophet Botiv''' was an entity in the religious cosmology of the [[Ugor/Legends|Ugors]]. Worshipers offered greetings in the prophet's name.<ref name="Scavenger Hunt" />
